scope: Only reached local-reference resolution failures and reached reference targets whose JSON kind is not a schema. Source admission, dialect keyword activation, ordinary validation diagnostics and native predicate/public FirstError boundaries stay unchanged.

mapping.selector: Reached local pointer/anchor resolution failure, including invalid array index or traversal through a scalar
mapping.message: Existing deterministic Rust local-resolution reason; native exception classes/messages are preserved as baseline evidence, not facade class-identity promises.

mapping.selector: Reached reference target other than object or boolean schema
mapping.message: Schema reference target is not an object or boolean schema
Draft 3 reference target is not an object schema
mapping.result: trusted ordered terminal; existing approved reason retained

orderedSemantics: AllErrors retains every publicly yielded diagnostic prefix, then exposes the trusted terminal at the next iterator step. FirstError stops at an earlier surfaced diagnostic. Internal candidate buffering and validity predicates retain the native short-circuit behavior frozen in the corpus. Do not flatten internal candidate errors or eagerly reach a reference the predecessor skips.
trustedOrigin: Never infer deferability from public error code/message/path. Only Rust evaluator-created semantic terminals may defer. Errors returned by meter/control/cancel/clock callbacks remain outer Err even if their public text collides or the host returns an EngineError previously obtained from a semantic kernel call. Use typed internal provenance or equivalent; public error envelopes stay unchanged.
noBroadClaim: This maps accepted/refused status and ordered outcomes for the qualified facade. It does not implement the entire jsonschema exception API or promise its Python class identity. Recursive nontermination is not probed by this corpus; existing cooperative depth/step resource rules remain in force.
